title: Media plane callbacks

delivery.auth: Every callback is a POST to callback.url with `Authorization: Bearer <callback.token>`, the token the room or egress request carried. The media plane signs nothing of its own.
delivery.events: At least once. A 2xx is delivered. A 4xx other than 408 or 429 is refused and not retried. Anything else (5xx, 408, 429, timeout, connection error) is retried with backoff: at least 4 attempts for room events, at least 5 for feed events, a few quick ones for frames batches (a stale frame is worthless, so the oldest waiting batch is dropped first). Order is not guaranteed: receivers dedupe on idempotencyKey (room.ended on roomId + event) and order on the event's own times.
delivery.requests: op requests (upload_url, credentials) are answered with JSON in the response body, retried up to 3 times; a 4xx other than 408/429 is final.
delivery.bounds: Queues are bounded; past the bound the oldest pending delivery is dropped and logged. Anything dropped is recoverable: GET /control/rooms/{roomId} for room state, the bucket prefix for segments.

roomEvent.title: Room event (room callback, for the events listed in options.events)

sessionId.description: This connection (an identity reconnecting is a new sessionId)

reason.description: participant.left: the roomClosed reason the client was given (replaced, a removal reason) or why the socket ended (socket_closed, left, …)

roomEnded.title: room.ended (room callback, always sent when a room has a callback)

egressFailed.title: egress.failed (room callback): the host running an egress session stopped responding

egressEnded.title: egress.session.ended (egress callback): the session reached a terminal state

feedEvent.title: Feed event (egress callback of a segments/frames session)

data.description: The sink's metadata (Senseplane: account_id, source_id) merged with the event's fields below

sourceOnline.title: source.online data: a run started (the publisher's video is being recorded). Key source.online:{sessionId}:{run}

codecs.description: Lower-case codec names, e.g. h264, opus

sourceOffline.title: source.offline data: a run ended. Key source.offline:{sessionId}:{run}

reason.description: publisher_left, publisher_replaced, ffmpeg_exited, stopped, node_lost, max_duration

segmentWritten.title: segment.written data: an object is in the bucket. Key segment.written:{key}

init_key.description: {keyPrefix}init/{sessionId}.mp4, {sessionId}-{run}.mp4 after the first run; always uploaded before the run's first segment

recordingGap.title: recording.gap data: time with no recording inside one session. Key recording.gap:{sessionId}:{run} or recording.gap:{key}

resolutionRejected.title: resolution_rejected data: the publisher is above maxResolution; nothing of this run was stored. The caller decides whether to remove the participant. Key resolution_rejected:{sessionId}:{run}

uploadUrlRequest.title: op upload_url (egress callback, presign-callback destination): one per object

url.description: A presigned PUT, valid for about a minute. A credential: never logged

headers.description: Extra headers to send with the PUT

credentialsRequest.title: op credentials (egress callback, s3 destination): fresh credentials before expiresAt

framesBatch.title: frames batch (egress callback of a frames sink): at least every batchMs of the sink (default 1000) while frames flow, multipart/form-data
framesBatch.description: Parts: `meta` (application/json, this schema), `frame0`..`frame4` (image/jpeg, 640x360, letterboxed, ≤ fps of the sink), `audio` (application/octet-stream, f32le mono 16 kHz, about 1 s). Batches are fire and forget: stale ones are dropped, not queued. The sink's batchMs (100–1000, default 1000) sets how often the frames gathered so far are sent: alerts wait on the batch, so sooner is faster. Key frames:{sessionId}:{sequence}.

whipAuthorizeRequest.title: WHIP authorize (POST authorize_url from the WHIP bearer, with the bearer as Authorization)

token.description: A join token for the bearer's room (aliases accepted by media planes: joinToken, join_token)

mediaUrl.description: Signalling url to join with; default the media plane's own (alias media_url)
